name: browsing-reddit
title_zh: Reddit 帖子压缩成表格，评论区也能整页读
tagline_zh: 刷 r/ 不再被楼层和长文淹没——帖子、评论、子版块、用户全压成紧凑表格，一次翻页看完整条讨论链。
tagline_en: Tired of Reddit's noisy threads? Posts, comments, subreddits, users all become tight tables—read whole.
desc_en: Browse, search, and read Reddit via rdt-tidy compact tables (posts, comments, subreddits, users). Use when the user asks to read a Reddit post or its comments, search Reddit or within a subreddit, browse a subreddit or feed, check a subreddit or user, or mentions reddit, subreddit, r/, rdt, rdt-tidy, or pastes a reddit.com link - even for one-off lookups where token-cheap output matters.
why_zh: 不是抓网页原文，而是用 rdt-tidy 的结构化输出重排信息层级，评论缩进和折叠逻辑保留。
why_en: It restructures Reddit's raw HTML into rdt-tidy's clean tables—keeps comment nesting and collapse logic, so you scan more per.
limit_zh: 只认 Reddit 公开内容，需联网且目标 subreddit 未被封锁；不处理需登录的私密版块。
limit_en: Public Reddit only, needs network; locked/private subs fail. Media stays as links, no embeds. Very long threads may overflow table width.
title_en: Reddit posts & comments as compact tables
